messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — code block in /docs/runtime/quickstart.md is rendering as inline text (fenced backticks stripped). Looks like the triple backticks were turned into HTML in the MDX build. Example snippet shows:
```js
fetch('/api/generate', { method: 'POST' })
```
Now displays as plain text. Can someone owning runtime quickstart take a look? /cc @Priya Rao

Priya Rao: I can take it. Do you know which commit introduced the change? :eyes:

Alex Chen: Not sure, spotted in prod docs site just now. Link: https://internal.docs/redwood/runtime/quickstart

docs-bot: automated-docs-lint found 1 markdown-fence-warning in /runtime/quickstart.md line 42. Suggests missing closing fence. See CI run: https://ci/internal/1234

Priya Rao: OK thanks — if it's a missing closing fence I can patch quickly. Maria, are you on the quickstart ownership rotation this week? @Maria Gomez

Maria Gomez: Not primary this week but can help review. If it's a one-line fix I'll open a PR and assign Jon for quick review.

Jon S: happy to review. If it's a bad render from MDX we might need to escape backticks: `` `\` `` or use <pre><code> block. Also check frontmatter `render: mdx` flag.

Priya Rao: I opened a tiny branch: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/789 — includes closing fence and an explicit codeblock language. Ran local build and snippet renders. Can someone review? :thumbsup:

Jon S: Reviewing now. Quick nit: update the alt text for the screenshot while you're at it.

Maria Gomez: Reviewed and approved, Jon approved as well. Merged and deployed.

Alex Chen: Verified on prod — snippet looks good, thanks everyone :tada:

Priya Rao: added a short note to the docs owner list to claim the quickstart for next rotation.

docs-bot: link-checker ran post-merge: 0 broken links, 0 warnings.

Alex Chen: closing loop — thanks y'all.
